u0: Initial progress: the agent has not yet held the yellow key on any qualifying move and is not carrying it. Objective: locate and pick up the yellow key; the first step where has_key is true advances to u1 and gives the first count.
u1: Partial progress: the agent has held the yellow key on exactly one qualifying move so far, but not two. It may currently possess the key or have dropped/lost it. Objective: if still holding it, keep possession through the next has_key step to reach u2; if empty-handed, find and pick up the yellow key again, then remain holding it on a later move.
u2: Final success state: the yellow key has been held on at least two distinct moves. The task is complete, and this state is terminal/absorbing; no further key-holding objective remains.
